name: Gouhara Masako
source:
She is a strong narcissist and her favorite flower is a rose.
Since birth she has had no connection with the opposite sex, and is a virgin of steel.
Even though she never dated, Masako knows a lot about strange things.
Masako is always bullying the cat she keeps at her home. She also loves to undress her bagworm moth, Mino.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
